helper = await rlm('''Answer in exactly one sentence: why should supporting references point at an earlier accepted layer? Do not read, search, modify, or write any graph records. Reply with the sentence only.''', name='freshness-reference-rationale', model='relayer-openrouter-b3BlbnJvdXRlci1saXZl/qwen/qwen3.8-flash')
print(helper)

search_result = await graph.search(GraphSearchRequest(
    query="MATCH (l:Layer)-[:CONTAINS]->(n:Content) WHERE n.title = $title RETURN l AS layer ORDER BY layer ASC",
    parameters={"title": {"type":"string","value":"Freshness acknowledged"}},
))
print(search_result)

if search_result.get("truncated") is True:
    raise ValueError("Graph search results are truncated; narrow the query before selecting a layer.")
rows = search_result.get("rows")
if not isinstance(rows, list) or not rows:
    raise ValueError("Graph search returned no rows; no earlier accepted layer is available to reference.")
row = rows[0]
if not isinstance(row, list) or not row:
    raise ValueError("The first search row has no result cell.")
result = row[0]
if not isinstance(result, dict) or result.get("type") != "layer":
    raise ValueError("The search result is not a tagged layer.")
identity = result.get("id")
match = re.fullmatch(r"layer:([1-9][0-9]*)", identity) if isinstance(identity, str) else None
if match is None:
    raise ValueError("The tagged layer has an invalid public identity.")
evidence_layer_id = int(match.group(1))
if dict((p.get("name"), p.get("value",{}).get("value")) for p in result.get("properties",[]) if isinstance(p,dict)).get("state") != "accepted":
    raise ValueError("The referenced layer is not accepted.")

followup_node = await graph.submit_node(NodeObject(
    icon="link-2", title="Earlier explanation linked",
    detail="The earlier accepted freshness explanation is linked here as supporting context; it is not repeated.",
    client_key="freshness-followup-node"))
followup_layer = await graph.submit_layer(LayerObject(
    nodes=[followup_node], edges=[],
    layout=LayerLayoutObject([NodePlacementObject(followup_node, 0.5, 0.5)]),
    client_key="freshness-followup-layer"))
await graph.add_navigate_action(
    followup_node, "View the original explanation", evidence_layer_id,
    relation="reference", source_layer=followup_layer,
    client_key="freshness-followup-original-reference")
print('FOLLOWUP_LAYER', followup_layer)
submission = await graph.submit(9)
print('SUBMISSION', submission)
